info.title: LinkSnap API
info.description: REST API and canonical short-code redirect. See API.md for local cookie and CSRF setup. Responses can fail before route handling if the JSON body is malformed, oversized or uses unsupported encoding.

get.description: A recognized code is checked for active state and destination policy. Eligible GET requests can trigger best-effort analytics. Invalid or reserved route shapes can produce the generic route 404.

404.description: The short link is missing or unavailable.

parameters.name: shortCode
parameters.description: Case-sensitive short code; reserved paths excluded.

head.description: Uses the same redirect eligibility checks as GET and returns headers without a response body or click recording.

404.description: The short link or route is unavailable. HEAD has no body.

500.description: Unexpected server failure. HEAD has no body.

parameters.name: shortCode
parameters.description: Case-sensitive short code; reserved paths excluded.

get.description: Requires admin role. Flagged includes non-deleted, unblocked, unreviewed links with stored flags. Blocked includes non-deleted blocked links.
Requires admin role. Returns redacted destination metadata and audit history.

patch.summary: Review, block or unblock a link
patch.description: Requires admin role. Review needs the current updatedAt revision; unblock rechecks destination policy. Optional reportId must refer to this link.

409.description: The link is no longer eligible or its destination remains prohibited.

error.message: This link is no longer eligible for that action.

get.description: Requires admin role. Results are newest first, with a pending default.
Requires admin role. Returns the report history and related link if available; the fingerprint is excluded.

patch.description: Requires admin role. Review applies to pending reports. Dismiss or actioned apply to pending or reviewed reports. Performs no link state change.

409.description: The report no longer qualifies for the transition.

error.message: This report is no longer eligible for that decision.

get.description: Scoped to the authenticated owner. Traffic and date filters affect event metrics; lifetime counts ignore them.

Returns the current user's non-deleted links. Search matches literal substrings in code, destination and tags. Date filters are inclusive UTC days.

parameters.description: Expiration sorts latest deadlines first, then unset deadlines.

post.description: Applies changes per owned eligible link. Duplicate IDs are collapsed. Missing, foreign, deleted and ineligible links count as skipped. Enable cannot clear a security block.

get.description: Returns owned, non-deleted link totals, seven-day activity and up to five rows per recent list.
Current state and destination policy are checked. Only hostname, protocol, caution flag and canonical relative path are exposed. No click is recorded.

To.name: to
To.description: Inclusive final day in UTC; defaults to today.

Interval.name: interval
Interval.description: Daily defaults to 30 days, up to 90 days within retention. Hourly defaults to today, up to 7 days.
